evals.name: Remove duplicate helper functions
evals.description: Given two modules with identical helper functions, extract to shared utility
evals.input: Two Python files each containing a duplicate `format_date()` function
evals.expected: Single shared `format_date()` in a utils module with imports in both original files
criteria: Both modules import from the shared utility

evals.name: Convert verbose loops to comprehensions
evals.description: Replace manual for-loop with append pattern using list/dict comprehensions
evals.input: Python code with for loops that build lists or dicts via append/assignment

evals.name: Extract base class from duplicated service classes
evals.description: Given multiple service classes with identical CRUD methods, create a base class
evals.input: Two or more service classes with repeated get_all, get_by_id, create methods
evals.expected: Abstract base class with shared methods, subclasses with only model-specific attributes
criteria: Base class encapsulates all shared logic
No behavioral change in subclass methods
